/ekskjˈuːs miː ɑː juː ˈəʊpən ˌəʊvə ðə bæŋk ˈhɒlɪdˌeɪ/
What time do you close tomorrow?
/wɒt taɪm duː juː kləʊz təmˈɒrəʊ/

per_page.title: 请假前交接工作
sample_ipa: Could we go over the open tasks before I take leave?
/kʊd wiː ɡəʊ ˌəʊvə ðɪ ˈəʊpən tɑːsks bɪfˌɔːr aɪ teɪk liːv/
Who can cover urgent customer questions while I'm away?
/huː kæn ˈkʌvər ˈɜːdʒənt ˈkʌstəmə ˈkwestʃənz waɪl aɪm əwˈeɪ/

per_page.title: 等待预订餐桌
sample_ipa: Hello, we have a booking for two under Chen.
/həlˈəʊ wiː hæv ə ˈbʊkɪŋ fɔː tuː ˌʌndə tʃen/
Do you know roughly how long we'll need to wait?
/duː juː nəʊ ˈrʌfli haʊ lɒŋ wiːl niːd tə weɪt/

per_page.title: 回顾年度经验教训
sample_ipa: Could we finish the year by reviewing what we've learned?
/kʊd wiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə jiə baɪ rɪvjˈuːɪŋ wɒt wiːv lɜːnd/
What worked better than we expected?
/wɒt wɜːkt ˈbetə ðən wiː ekspˈektɪd/

per_page.title: 规划返程交通
sample_ipa: What's the easiest way to get to the airport from here?
/wɒts ðɪ ˈiːzɪəst weɪ tə ɡet tə ðɪ ˈeəpɔːt frɒm hiə/
How early should I leave for a morning flight?
/haʊ ˈɜːli ʃʊd aɪ liːv fərə ˈmɔːnɪŋ flaɪt/
